uz:
🚪 YANGI: Ochiq lobbilar, sherik qidirib yurmang
Hozir kimdir o'ynashga tayyor. «Ochiq lobbilar» ro'yxatidan stolni tanlang va «Qo'shilish» ni bosing: bir necha soniyada o'yindasiz. Saralash bor: bo'sh joylar, ovozli xona, do'stlar.
en:
🚪 NEW: Open lobbies, stop hunting for a partner
Pick a table in the "Open lobbies" list and tap Join: you are in a game within seconds. Filters: free seats, voice room, friends.

uz:
⚡ «Tez qo'shilish»: bitta tugma, tayyor o'yin
Kutib o'tirish yo'q. Bosing, o'yin sizga mos ochiq lobbi topadi. Topilmasa, o'zi yangi ochiq lobbi ochadi va boshqalar sizga qo'shiladi.
en:
⚡ Quick join: one button, a game right now
Tap it and the game finds an open lobby for you. If there is none, it opens a public lobby itself and others can join you.

uz:
🎙 YANGI: Ovozli xona, lobbida jonli gaplashing
Lobbida «Ovozli xona» tugmasini bosing: hamma bir-birini eshitadi, xuddi bir davrada o'tirgandek. Sakkiz kishigacha. Mikrofon bo'lmasa ham «faqat eshitish» rejimi ishlaydi.
en:
🎙 NEW: Voice room, talk live in the lobby
Tap "Voice room" in the lobby and everyone hears each other, up to eight players. No microphone? Listen-only mode still works.

uz:
🎧 Ovozli xona uch qadamda
1) Lobbi oching yoki kod bilan qo'shiling.
2) «Ovozli xona» tugmasini bosing va mikrofonga ruxsat bering.
3) Do'stlaringiz ham bossa, hammasi bir-birini eshitadi.
Telefonda quloqchin bilan o'ynash yaxshiroq: aks-sado bo'lmaydi.
en:
🎧 The voice room in three steps
1) Open a lobby or join with a code. 2) Tap "Voice room" and allow the microphone. 3) When your friends do too, everyone hears each other. Headphones are better: no echo.

uz:
🎤 O'yin vaqtida ham ovoz bilan
Raqib bilan jonli gaplashing: zo'r zarbaga qoyil qoling yoki hazillashing. Xohlamasangiz, mikrofonni o'chiring: yozma tezkor xabarlar va stikerlar ham bor.
en:
🎤 Voice during the match, too
Talk live with your opponent: cheer a great shot or crack a joke. Prefer silence? Mute the mic; quick messages and stickers are there as well.

uz:
🏠 Do'stlar bilan lobbi: kod yuboring, o'ynang
Lobbi oching, kod yoki havolani do'stingizga yuboring. Sakkiz kishigacha yig'ilasiz: o'yinchi qancha ko'p bo'lsa, sovrin shuncha katta.
en:
🏠 A lobby with friends: send the code and play
Open a lobby and send the code or link to a friend. Up to eight players: the more players, the bigger the prize.

uz:
👥 Bitta telefonda ikki kishi
Do'stingiz yoningizdami? «2 o'yinchi, bitta qurilma» rejimida navbatma-navbat o'ynang. Kim kuchli ekanini hozir aniqlang!
en:
👥 Two players, one phone
Your friend is right next to you? Play turn by turn in "2 players, one device" mode. Find out who is stronger, right now!

uz:
👀 Do'stlaringiz o'yinini jonli kuzating
«Tomosha» bo'limida «Do'stlar» yorlig'ini oching: ular hozir qaysi stolda o'ynayotganini ko'rasiz. «Top o'yinlar» da eng kuchlilarning o'yini. Davlat bo'yicha saralash ham bor.
en:
👀 Watch your friends play, live
Open the "Friends" tab in Watch to see which table they are at right now. "Top games" shows the strongest players. You can also filter by country.

uz:
💬 Tezkor xabarlar: bir bosishda
O'yin paytida salom ayting, omad tilang, «zo'r zarba!» deng yoki rahmat ayting: hammasi bitta tugma bilan. Raqibga hurmat o'yinning bir qismi.
en:
💬 Quick messages: one tap
Say hello, wish good luck, call a shot great or say thanks during the match: all in one tap. Respect for your opponent is part of the game.

uz:
🎁 Raqibga sovg'a yuboring
O'yin vaqtida sovg'a uchib boradi: yurak, yonca, shokolad, gul, tort, medal, toj, olmos, mototsikl, mashina, samolyot... Jami 13 xil! Har kuni 1 ta yonca va 1 ta shokolad bepul, yurak 15 🪙 (kuniga 5 tagacha).
en:
🎁 Send a gift to your opponent
During the match a gift flies across the screen: a heart, clover, chocolate, bouquet, cake, medal, crown, gem, bike, car, jet... 13 gifts in all! One clover and one chocolate are free every day, a heart costs 15 🪙 (up to 5 a day).

uz:
👍 Sovg'a: hurmat belgisi
Har sovg'aning o'z 👍 qiymati bor: yurak ×1, yonca ×20, shokolad ×50... samolyot ×7 000 gacha. Olgan 👍 laringiz sizda yig'iladi. Yaxshi o'yin uchun raqibni siylang!
en:
👍 A gift is a mark of respect
Each gift has its own 👍 value: heart ×1, clover ×20, chocolate ×50... up to jet ×7,000. The 👍 you receive add up. Treat your opponent after a good game!

uz:
🎭 Stikerlar: his-tuyg'ularingizni ko'rsating
6 ta to'plam: Bilyard, Hayvonlar, Kulgi, Taom, Sehr va Mehr: jami 50 dan ortiq stiker. O'yin chatidagi 🎭 tugmasi bilan raqibga yuboriladi. Har to'plam 10 💵 yoki 100 💎.
en:
🎭 Stickers: show how you feel
6 packs: Billiards, Animals, Funny, Food, Magic and Hearts, over 50 stickers. Send them with the 🎭 button in the match chat. A pack costs 10 💵 or 100 💎.

uz:
🎱 Kiylar: 470 dan ortiq, har birining o'z xarakteri
Har kiyda 4 ko'rsatkich bor: kuch, aniqlik, aylanish va vaqt. Kolleksiyangizni to'ldiring va o'z uslubingizga mos kiyni toping!
en:
🎱 Cues: over 470 of them, each with its own character
Every cue has 4 stats: force, aim, spin and time. Build your collection and find the cue that fits your style!

uz:
🌍 Har bir davlatning o'z kiyi bor
199 ta davlat kiyi, har birida o'sha davlat bayrog'i ranglari. O'zbekiston kiyi ham bor 🇺🇿 O'z bayrog'ingiz bilan o'ynang!
en:
🌍 Every country has its own cue
199 country cues, each in the colours of its flag. Uzbekistan's is there too 🇺🇿 Play with your own flag!

uz:
💀 Qo'rqinchli kiylar: qorong'u uslub
Sirli tun, Yarim tun, Qabr qo'ng'irog'i, Kabus o'rmoni... 12 ta qo'rqinchli kiy. Do'kondagi haftalik «Qo'rqinchli» takliflar aylanib turadi, ekranda taymer bor.
en:
💀 Horror cues: the dark style
Mystic Night, Midnight, Grave Bell and more: 12 horror cues. The shop's weekly horror offers rotate, with a timer on screen.

uz:
🏆 Victory kiylari: g'alaba bilan yig'iladi
Ko'rsatilgan shaharda (yoki undan yuqorida) yuting va bo'laklarni to'plang. 4 bo'lak = 1 kiy. Har g'alaba sizni maqsadga yaqinlashtiradi.
en:
🏆 Victory cues: earned by winning
Win in the listed city (or above) to collect pieces. 4 pieces = 1 cue. Every win brings you closer.

uz:
🎁 Syurpriz kiylar: omad bilan afsonaviy kiy
Syurpriz qutilar ichidan afsonaviy kiylar ham chiqadi: Axiom, Crystal Blade va boshqalar. Qutini oching va nima chiqishini ko'ring!
en:
🎁 Surprise cues: a legendary cue by luck
Surprise boxes can hold legendary cues such as Axiom and Crystal Blade. Open a box and see what you get!

uz:
🪵 Boshlash uchun pul kerak emas
Boshlang'ich kiy doim bepul. Keyin oddiy kiylarni tangaga olasiz: Chinor, Konfet va boshqalar. Tanga o'yinda yutiladi va bepul sovg'alardan tushadi.
en:
🪵 You do not need money to start
The starter cue is always free. Then buy standard cues with coins: Plane Tree, Candy and more. Coins are won in matches and come from free rewards.

uz:
👑 Premium kiylar: atigi 300 dan 5 000 gacha nusxa
Bronzadan Kamalak opalgacha 12 daraja. Har birining soni cheklangan: eng nodiri, Kamalak opal, bor-yo'g'i 300 dona. Har bir egasi tartib raqami (№) oladi.
en:
👑 Premium cues: only 300 to 5,000 copies
12 tiers from Bronze to Rainbow Opal, each in a fixed number of copies. The rarest, Rainbow Opal, exists in just 300. Every owner gets a serial number (№).

uz:
🪑 150 dan ortiq stol: sizning uslubingiz
Shahar stollaridan tashqari kolleksiya stollari ham bor. Tanlangan stol hamma o'yinlaringizda ko'rinadi. Shahar uzugini yutsangiz, o'sha shahar stoli bepul.
en:
🪑 Over 150 tables to match your style
Besides the city tables there are collector tables. The table you pick shows in all your games. Win a city ring and that city's table is yours for free.

uz:
🔥 Haftaning stoli: −40%
Har hafta do'konda bitta stol chegirma bilan taklif qilinadi. Yangisi dushanba kuni chiqadi. Bu hafta qaysi stol chegirmada ekanini «Stollar» bo'limida ko'ring.
en:
🔥 Table of the week: −40%
Every week one table is offered at a discount. A new one appears on Monday. See which table it is this week in the shop's Tables section.

uz:
🔢 Cheklangan nashr: №1 dan №300 gacha
Eng nodir stollar, kiylar va ramkalar belgilangan sonda chiqariladi. Har bir egasi o'z tartib raqamini oladi. Nodir stolda o'ynasangiz, o'yin boshida «Cheklangan nashr · № 17 / 300» ko'rinadi.
en:
🔢 Limited editions: №1 to №300
The rarest tables, cues and frames exist in a fixed number of copies. Every owner gets a serial number. Play on a rare table and the match intro shows "Limited edition · № 17 / 300".

uz:
🧑 Avatar: o'yindagi yuzingiz
76 ta portret avatar bepul! Premium avatarlar 70 ta, noyoblik darajasi 5 xil: Oddiydan Mifikkacha. Reytingda, lobbida va stolda hamma sizni shu rasm bilan ko'radi.
en:
🧑 Avatar: your face in the game
76 portrait avatars are free! There are 70 premium avatars in 5 rarities, from Common to Mythic. Everyone sees this picture in the ranking, the lobby and at the table.

uz:
🖼 Ramka: profilingizga hashamat qo'shing
120 dan ortiq ramka: bronzadan brilliantgacha. Ramka avataringiz atrofida reytingda ham, lobbida ham ko'rinadi. Eng nodirlari cheklangan nashrda!
en:
🖼 Frames: add some glamour to your profile
Over 120 frames, from bronze to brilliant. The frame around your avatar shows in the ranking and in the lobby. The rarest are limited editions!

uz:
💍 Cheklangan ramkalar: Bronza 5 000, Opal 300
12 darajali seriya: Bronza, Kumush, Oltin, Pushti oltin, Platina, Sapfir, Zumrad, Yoqut, Ametist, Brilliant, Qora olmos, Kamalak opal. Daraja qancha yuqori bo'lsa, nusxa shuncha kam.
en:
💍 Limited frames: Bronze 5,000, Opal 300
A 12-tier series: Bronze up to Rainbow Opal. The higher the tier, the fewer copies exist.

uz:
🧰 Qutilar: Oddiy, Epik, Afsonaviy
Quti qanchalik yuqori bo'lsa, ichida shuncha ko'p sovg'a: 1, 2 yoki 3 ta. Nima chiqishini oldindan bilib bo'lmaydi, shuning uchun qiziq!
en:
🧰 Boxes: Rare, Epic, Legendary
The higher the box, the more perks inside: 1, 2 or 3. You never know what comes out, which is the fun of it!

uz:
🩸 Mavsum yo'li: 400 daraja, har oy yangi mavzu
G'alaba va vazifalar uchun ochko yig'ing: har daraja mukofot ochadi. Bepul yo'l hammaga, premium yo'lda yana ko'proq sovg'a. Kiylar, ramkalar, stollar va avatarlar.
en:
🩸 Season Pass: 400 levels, a new theme every month
Earn points from wins and missions; each level unlocks a reward. The free track is for everyone, the premium track has more. Cues, frames, tables and avatars.

uz:
🛣 Kubok yo'li: g'alaba, kubok, yangi shahar
Har g'alaba kubok keltiradi. Yo'lda sovg'alar kutadi va yangi shaharlar ochiladi. Yutqazganda yo'ldagi kubok kamaymaydi: faqat oldinga!
en:
🛣 Trophy Road: win, earn trophies, unlock cities
Every win brings trophies. Rewards wait along the road and new cities open. Trophies on the road are not lost when you lose: only forward!

uz:
📋 Kunlik vazifalar: har kuni yangi maqsad
«2 ta o'yinda g'alaba», «15 ta shar tushiring», «Omadli zarbani o'ynang»... Bajaring va mukofot oling.
en:
📋 Daily missions: a new goal every day
"Win 2 games", "Pot 15 balls", "Play the Lucky Shot"... Complete them and collect rewards.

uz:
🌍 Dunyo reytingi: butun dunyo bilan bellashing
Reytingda 5 ta jadval bor: Ligam, Do'stlar, Davlat, Dunyo va Klub ligalari. O'rin hafta davomida yutgan tangalaringizga qarab belgilanadi. Hafta yopilganda dunyo top-3 ga 1 500 / 750 / 400 💵 beriladi.
en:
🌍 World ranking: compete with the whole world
Five boards: My league, Friends, Country, World and Club leagues. Your place depends on the coins you win during the week. When the week closes, the world's top 3 get 1,500 / 750 / 400 💵.

uz:
🏳 Davlat reytingi: bayrog'ingiz uchun!
Har davlatning o'z reytingi bor. Haftalik top-3 ga 400 / 200 / 100 💵 beriladi. Ismingiz bayrog'ingiz bilan birga hammaga ko'rinadi. O'zbekistonni reytingda baland ko'taring 🇺🇿
en:
🏳 Country ranking: play for your flag!
Every country has its own ranking, and its weekly top 3 receive 400 / 200 / 100 💵. Your name shows next to your flag. Raise it high!

uz:
⭐ 10 ta liga: eng yuqorisi «To'qqiz ball championi»
Har hafta ligangizdagi taxminan 20% eng yaxshi o'yinchi yuqoriga ko'tariladi, oxirgi 20% pastga tushadi. Liga imtiyozi: g'alaba qutisidagi tanga ×4 gacha oshadi.
en:
⭐ 10 leagues, the top one is Nine-Ball Champion
Every week roughly the top 20% of your league move up and the bottom 20% move down. League perk: the coins in your victory box grow up to ×4.

uz:
🪪 Reyting qatori: sizning vizitkangiz
Ismingiz yonida avatar va ramkangiz, davlat bayrog'i, liga, klub va stol belgisi ko'rinadi. Cheklangan nashr stoli bo'lsa, tartib raqamingiz ham chiqadi!
en:
🪪 Your ranking row is your business card
Next to your name the ranking shows your avatar and frame, your country flag, league, club and table badge. Own a limited-edition table and your serial number shows too!

uz:
🛡 Klub: jamoa bilan g'alaba qozoning
6-darajadan boshlab klub yaratish yoki qo'shilish mumkin. Klubda 50 kishigacha, chat, sovg'alar va haftalik klublar ligasi bor: eng yaxshi uchta klubning har bir a'zosi 20 / 10 / 5 💵 oladi.
en:
🛡 Club: win together as a team
From level 6 you can create or join a club: up to 50 members, a chat, gifts and a weekly club league. Every member of the top three clubs receives 20 / 10 / 5 💵.

uz:
♞ Showdown: har g'alaba hisobga olinadi
Har g'alaba Showdown ochkosi va Gambit tokenini beradi. Ochko ko'paygan sari 8 ta mukofot ochiladi: tanga, token, 💵, quti, kiy bo'lagi va 💎. Hafta dushanba kuni yangilanadi.
en:
♞ Showdown: every win counts
Every win earns Showdown points and a Gambit token. Eight rewards unlock as the points add up: coins, tokens, 💵, a box, a cue piece and 💎. It resets every Monday.

uz:
🛍 Gambit do'koni: tokenlarga nimalar bor
Showdown tokenlariga Kolleksiya qutisi, Davlat qutisi, maxsus avatar va Grandmaster kiyi bo'laklarini olasiz. Tokenni o'yin bilan yig'asiz: xarid uchun pul kerak emas.
en:
🛍 Gambit Shop: what tokens can buy
Showdown tokens buy a Collection box, a Country box, a special avatar and pieces of the Grandmaster cue. You earn tokens by playing: no purchase needed.

uz:
👑 Grandmaster stoli: eng kuchlilar uchun
45 kubokka yetganingizda ochiladi. Maxsus stol, katta sovrin va afsonaviy Grandmaster kiyi: uni 40 ta bo'lakdan yig'asiz.
en:
👑 Grandmaster Table: for the strongest
It opens at 45 trophies. A special table with a big prize and the legendary Grandmaster cue, assembled from 40 pieces.

uz:
🏅 Kubok turnirlari: 32, 48 yoki 64 o'yinchi
Osiyo, Janubiy Amerika, Yevropa va Jahon Kubogi. Eng kattasi, Jahon Kubogi: 64 o'yinchi va 7 500 000 🪙 sovrin. Olimpiya tizimi: yutsangiz davom etasiz, yutqazsangiz chiqasiz.
en:
🏅 Cup tournaments: 32, 48 or 64 players
The Asia, South America, Europe and World Cups. The biggest, the World Cup: 64 players and a 7,500,000 🪙 prize. Knockout format: win to go on, lose and you are out.

uz:
🏙 30 shahar, 30 chempionat
Har shaharning o'z kubogi bor: 32 o'yinchi, o'sha shahar stolida o'ynaladi. Keyingi shaharning kubogi oldingisini yutganingizdan keyin ochiladi. Bugun qaysi shaharni zabt etasiz?
en:
🏙 30 cities, 30 championships
Every city has its own cup: 32 players, played on that city's table. The next city's cup opens once you have won the previous one. Which city will you conquer today?

uz:
⏰ Kunlik kubok: kuniga 4 marta
Toshkent vaqti bilan 09:00, 15:00, 21:00 va 03:00 da ochiladi, har biri 3 soat ochiq turadi. Birini o'tkazib yuborsangiz, keyingisi kutadi. Vaqtlar telefoningiz mintaqasiga moslab ko'rsatiladi.
en:
⏰ Daily cups: four times a day
They open at 09:00, 15:00, 21:00 and 03:00 Tashkent time and stay open for 3 hours each. Missed one? The next is waiting. Times are shown in your phone's time zone.

uz:
🌙 To'rtta kunlik kubok: Ertalabki, Tushki, Kechki, Tungi
Kirish 1 000 dan 10 000 🪙 gacha, sovrin 30 000 dan 400 000 🪙 gacha. Tungi Kubok eng katta: 400 000 🪙. Har birida 32 o'yinchi.
en:
🌙 Four daily cups: Morning, Noon, Evening, Night
Entry from 1,000 to 10,000 🪙, prizes from 30,000 up to 400,000 🪙. The Night Cup is the biggest: 400,000 🪙. 32 players each.

uz:
💍 Shahar uzuklari: 30 shahar, 30 uzuk
Har shaharda g'alaba uchun kubok yig'iladi. Maqsadga yetsangiz, o'sha shaharning uzugi sizniki: Showdown ochkolariga +50% va shahar stoli bepul. Uzuklar yangi kubok turnirlarini ochadi!
en:
💍 City rings: 30 cities, 30 rings
Win trophies at each table. Reach the goal and that city's ring is yours: +50% Showdown points and the city table for free. Rings open new cup tournaments!

uz:
🥇 Birinchi uzuk: atigi 4 ta g'alaba
London stolida uzuk uchun 15 kubok kerak, har g'alaba +4 kubok beradi, mag'lubiyatda esa kubok yo'qolmaydi. Demak, 4 ta g'alaba: uzuk sizniki. Sidneyda esa 5 ta g'alaba!
en:
🥇 Your first ring: just 4 wins
At the London table the ring needs 15 trophies, each win gives +4 and a loss costs nothing. So 4 wins and the ring is yours. In Sydney it takes 5 wins!

uz:
🏅 32 ta medal: har biri +1 000 🪙
Birinchi o'yin, 5 ta ketma-ket g'alaba, 100 ta shar, klubga qo'shilish, turnirda g'alaba... Har yangi medal 1 000 🪙 beradi. Profilingizda nechtasini yig'dingiz?
en:
🏅 32 medals: +1,000 🪙 for each
Your first game, 5 wins in a row, 100 balls potted, joining a club, winning a tournament... Every new medal pays 1,000 🪙. How many have you collected?

uz:
🔥 Qiyin medallar: kim birinchi?
«Shafqatsiz»: raqib birorta shar tushirmasidan yuting. «Sovuq qon»: ketma-ket 10 g'alaba. «Ajoyib o'yin»: bitta zarbada 2 ta shar. «Tezkor»: sindirishda shar tushiring.
en:
🔥 Hard medals: who is first?
"Merciless": win before your opponent pots a ball. "Cold blood": 10 wins in a row. "Great game": 2 balls in one shot. "Quick": pot a ball on the break.

uz:
🤝 Do'stlar bo'limi: taklif kodi va havola
Shaxsiy kodingiz bilan do'stlaringizni qo'shing va ularning onlayn ekanini ko'ring. Birga o'ynash yakka o'yindan qiziqroq: lobbiga chaqiring yoki o'yinini tomosha qiling.
en:
🤝 The Friends section: your code and link
Add friends with your personal code and see when they are online. Playing together beats playing alone: invite them to a lobby or watch their match.

uz:
🎁 Do'stingizga har kuni 500 🪙 sovg'a qiling
«Do'stlar» bo'limida «Sovg'a yuborish» ni bosing: har bir do'stga kuniga bir marta 500 🪙 yuboriladi. Siz uchun bepul, do'stingiz xursand bo'ladi. Ularning sovg'asini ham kuting!
en:
🎁 Send each friend 500 🪙 every day
Tap "Send gift" in the Friends section: each friend gets 500 🪙 once a day. It costs you nothing and makes your friend happy. Expect their gifts, too!

uz:
📣 Chempion bo'lsangiz, do'stlaringiz bilib oladi
Kubokni yutganingizda do'stlaringiz va klub a'zolaringizga xabar boradi. G'alabangizni ko'rsatish uchun alohida post yozish shart emas.
en:
📣 Win a cup and your friends will know
When you win a championship cup, your friends and club mates are told. No need to write a post to show off.

uz:
❓ Bu o'yin bepulmi?
Ha, boshlash bepul. Kunlik sovg'a, omad g'ildiragi, vazifalar, turnirlar: hammasi bepul. Do'kon ixtiyoriy: kiy, stol yoki ramka olishni o'zingiz hal qilasiz.
en:
❓ Is the game free?
Yes, starting is free. The daily gift, the lucky wheel, missions and tournaments are all free. The shop is optional: you decide whether to get a cue, table or frame.

uz:
❓ Bu pul o'yinimi?
Yo'q. Tanga, 💵 va 💎 faqat o'yin ichida ishlaydi, yutuqlar ham o'yin ichidagi sovg'alardir. Bu bilyard o'yini: maqsad zavq, mahorat va raqobat.
en:
❓ Is it a money game?
No. Coins, 💵 and 💎 work only inside the game, and prizes are in-game rewards. This is a pool game: the goal is fun, skill and competition.

uz:
❓ Qanday boshlayman?
Telegram'da botni oching va «O'ynash» ni bosing: yuklab olish yoki o'rnatish shart emas. O'yin brauzerda ham ochiladi. Birinchi stol, London, hammaga ochiq.
en:
❓ How do I start?
Open the bot in Telegram and tap Play: no download or install. The game also opens in a browser. The first table, London, is open to everyone.

uz:
❓ Raqib topilmasa nima bo'ladi?
Onlayn raqib topilmasa, o'yin sizni bot bilan o'ynatadi, kutib o'tirmaysiz. Bunday o'yin reytingga kirmaydi. Haqiqiy raqib uchun «Ochiq lobbilar» yoki do'stingizni lobbiga chaqiring.
en:
❓ What if no opponent is found?
If no online opponent is found, the game lets you play a bot instead of waiting. Such a game does not count for the ranking. For a human opponent use "Open lobbies" or invite a friend to a lobby.

uz:
🎁 Kunlik sovg'alar yo'li: 8 kunlik sovg'alar
1-kun 100 🪙, 2-kun Omadli zarba, 3-kun 300 🪙, 4-kun 1 💵, 5-kun omad g'ildiragi, 6-kun 1 000 🪙, 7-kun 2 💵 va katta sovrin, 8-kun 2 500 🪙. Bugungi sovg'ani oldingizmi?
en:
🎁 The daily reward route: 8 days of gifts
Day 1: 100 🪙, day 2: a Lucky Shot, day 3: 300 🪙, day 4: 1 💵, day 5: a wheel spin, day 6: 1,000 🪙, day 7: 2 💵 and a big prize, day 8: 2,500 🪙. Did you collect today's gift?

uz:
🎡 Omad g'ildiragi: 8 ta sektor
500, 1 000 yoki 2 000 🪙, 15, 25 yoki 35 💎, 1 yoki 5 💵. Har 24 soatda bitta aylantirish bepul. Bugun qaysi sektor tushadi?
en:
🎡 The lucky wheel: 8 sectors
500, 1,000 or 2,000 🪙, 15, 25 or 35 💎, 1 or 5 💵. One spin is free every 24 hours. Which sector will you land on today?

uz:
📊 Profil: o'yin tarixingiz bir joyda
O'yinlar, g'alabalar, jami yutuq, haftalik reyting, medallar va kubok yo'li: hammasi profilingizda. Har g'alaba bilan raqamlar o'sadi.
en:
📊 Profile: your game history in one place
Games, wins, total winnings, weekly ranking, medals and the trophy road: all in your profile. The numbers grow with every win.

uz:
🎨 Har shaharning o'z rangi
London ko'k, Sidney yashil, Madrid qizil, Las-Vegas qora, Qohira oltin-sariq, Seul binafsha, Rio yorqin yashil... Stol sukno rangi shaharga qarab o'zgaradi. Sevimli stolingiz qaysi?
en:
🎨 Every city has its own colour
London blue, Sydney green, Madrid red, Las Vegas black, Cairo golden, Seoul violet, Rio bright green... The cloth changes with the city. Which table is your favourite?

uz:
🧩 Kiy bo'laklarini qayerdan olasiz?
Victory kiylari: shaharda g'alaba qozonib (4 bo'lak = 1 kiy). Showdown mukofoti. Ligadagi imtiyoz: +1 bo'lak. Gambit do'koni: Grandmaster bo'laklari.
en:
🧩 Where do cue pieces come from?
Victory cues: win in a city (4 pieces = 1 cue). Showdown rewards. A league perk: +1 piece. The Gambit shop: Grandmaster pieces.

uz:
🤖 Hozir o'ynamoqchimisiz? Kutish yo'q
Raqib topish uzoq cho'zilsa, bot bilan o'ynaysiz, kutmaysiz. Mashq rejimida esa istalgancha zarba urib mahoratingizni oshirasiz: bu yerda hech kim shoshirmaydi.
en:
🤖 Want to play right now? No waiting
If finding an opponent takes long, you play a bot instead. In Practice mode you can shoot as much as you like and sharpen your skill: nobody rushes you.

uz:
📲 Yaxshi o'yin do'stingizga ham yoqadi
Botni do'stingizga yuboring va birga lobbiga kiring. Ovozli xona bilan hazillashib o'ynash yanada qiziqarli. Kanalimizga ham taklif qiling!
en:
📲 Your friend will like a good game, too
Send the bot to a friend and join a lobby together. With the voice room, playing and joking around is even more fun. Invite them to the channel as well!

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: 9-ball o'yinida oq shar bilan birga stolda nechta shar bo'ladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many balls are on the table in 9-ball, cue ball included?

explanation.uz: 9 ta raqamli shar va oq shar: jami 10 ta.
explanation.en: Nine numbered balls plus the cue ball: 10 in all.

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: 9-ball'da oq shar avval qaysi sharga tegishi kerak?
quiz.en: Quiz: in 9-ball, which ball must the cue ball hit first?
options: Eng katta raqamli sharga / The highest-numbered ball
Eng kichik raqamli sharga / The lowest-numbered ball

explanation.uz: Doim stoldagi eng kichik raqamli sharga.
explanation.en: Always the lowest-numbered ball left on the table.

quiz.uz: 🏆 Viktorina: 9-ball'da g'alaba uchun qaysi sharni qoidaga ko'ra tushirish kerak?
quiz.en: Quiz: in 9-ball, which ball wins the game when pocketed legally?

explanation.en: Pocketing the 9-ball legally wins the game.

quiz.uz: 💎 Viktorina: 9-ball'da sharlar qanday shaklda teriladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: in what shape are the balls racked in 9-ball?

explanation.en: A diamond of 1-2-3-2-1 rows, with the 9-ball in the middle.

quiz.uz: 🔺 Viktorina: 8-ball'da 15 shar uchburchakda nechta qatorga teriladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: in how many rows are the 15 balls racked in a triangle?

quiz.uz: ➕ Viktorina: 1 dan 15 gacha raqamli sharlarning raqamlari yig'indisi nechaga teng?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is the sum of the numbers on balls 1 to 15?

quiz.uz: 🔴 Viktorina: snukerda stolda nechta qizil shar bor?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many red balls are there in snooker?

explanation.uz: 15 qizil, 6 rangli va oq shar: jami 22 ta.
explanation.en: 15 reds, 6 colours and the cue ball: 22 in all.

quiz.uz: 🎯 Viktorina: snukerda eng yuqori mumkin bo'lgan seriya (maksimum break) necha ochko?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is the maximum possible break in snooker?

explanation.en: 15 reds + 15 blacks = 120, the colours add 27: 147.

quiz.uz: ⚫ Viktorina: snukerda qora shar necha ochko beradi?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many points is the black ball worth in snooker?

explanation.en: Black is worth 7, pink 6 and blue 5.

quiz.uz: 📏 Viktorina: to'liq o'lchamli snuker stoli necha futlik?
quiz.en: Quiz: how long is a full-size snooker table?

explanation.en: 12 ft, about 3.6 metres.

quiz.uz: 🕳 Viktorina: karambol bilyardi stolida nechta cho'ntak bor?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many pockets does a carom billiards table have?

explanation.uz: Karambolda cho'ntak yo'q, ochko sharlarni urib olinadi.
explanation.en: Carom has no pockets: you score by hitting balls.

quiz.uz: 🌀 Viktorina: «masse» zarbasi nima?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is a "masse" shot?
options: Oq sharni sakratish / Jumping the cue ball
Kiy tik tutilib, oq shar egri yo'ldan yuradi / Cue held steeply, the ball curves

explanation.uz: Kiy deyarli tik tutiladi va oq shar yoy bo'ylab yuradi.
explanation.en: The cue is almost vertical and the ball curves.

quiz.uz: 🦘 Viktorina: oq sharni to'siq shar ustidan sakratib o'tkazish qanday ataladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is it called when the cue ball is jumped over a blocking ball?

explanation.uz: Jump shot: oq shar havoga ko'tarilib to'siqdan oshadi.
explanation.en: A jump shot lifts the cue ball over the obstacle.

quiz.uz: 🔁 Viktorina: oq shar avval bortga tegib, keyin nishon sharga borsa, bu qanday zarba?
quiz.en: Quiz: the cue ball hits a cushion first, then the object ball. What shot is it?

explanation.uz: Kick shot: yo'l to'silganda bort orqali aylanib borasiz.
explanation.en: A kick shot goes round a blocked path via a cushion.

quiz.uz: 📐 Viktorina: nishon shar bortga tegib keyin cho'ntakka tushsa, bu qanday zarba?
quiz.en: Quiz: the object ball hits a cushion and then drops in a pocket. What is it?

explanation.uz: Bank shot: nishon shar bortdan qaytib cho'ntakka kiradi.
explanation.en: In a bank shot the object ball rebounds into a pocket.

quiz.uz: 🔗 Viktorina: oq shar bitta sharni uradi, u esa boshqa sharni cho'ntakka tushiradi. Bu...
quiz.en: Quiz: the cue ball hits one ball, which pockets another. This is a...

explanation.en: A combination (combo): a chain hit through two balls.

quiz.uz: ✋ Viktorina: kiyni tayanch qiladigan qo'l (yoki asbob) inglizcha nima deyiladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is the hand (or tool) that supports the cue called in English?

explanation.uz: Bridge: kiy silliq yurishi uchun tayanch.
explanation.en: The bridge steadies the cue as it slides.

quiz.uz: 🔺 Viktorina: sharlarni birinchi zarbadan oldin teradigan uchburchak asbob nima deyiladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is the triangle used to arrange the balls before the break called?

explanation.uz: Rack sharlarni zich va tekis teradi.
explanation.en: The rack packs the balls tight and even.

quiz.uz: 🧱 Viktorina: stolning yumshoq chetini (bort) inglizcha nima deyishadi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is the table's cushioned edge called in English?

explanation.uz: Cushion yoki rail: sharlar undan qaytadi.
explanation.en: The cushion (or rail) bounces the balls back.

quiz.uz: 🟩 Viktorina: stol ustidagi yumshoq mato (sukno) inglizcha nima?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is the soft cloth covering the table called?

explanation.uz: Felt: stol suknosi. O'yinda uning rangi shaharga qarab o'zgaradi.
explanation.en: The felt is the table cloth; in the game its colour changes with the city.

quiz.uz: 🛑 Viktorina: oq shar nishon sharga tekkach joyida to'xtaydigan zarba qanday ataladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is the shot called where the cue ball stops dead after contact?

explanation.uz: To'g'ri zarbadan keyin oq shar joyida to'xtaydi (markazdan sal pastga uriladi).
explanation.en: Hit slightly below centre and the cue ball stops in place after a straight hit.

quiz.uz: ⏩ Viktorina: oq sharning yuqori qismiga urib, u nishonga tekkach oldinga yuradigan zarba?
quiz.en: Quiz: hit above centre so the cue ball keeps rolling forward after contact. What is it?

explanation.uz: Follow: yuqoridan urish oq sharni oldinga yuritadi.
explanation.en: Follow: hitting high keeps the cue ball rolling forward.

quiz.uz: 💥 Viktorina: o'yinning birinchi zarbasi, terilgan sharlarni sochib yuboradigan zarba nima deyiladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is the first shot of the game, scattering the racked balls, called?

explanation.uz: Break: terilgan sharlarni sochuvchi birinchi zarba.
explanation.en: The break scatters the racked balls.

quiz.uz: 👻 Viktorina: «xayoliy shar» (ghost ball) usuli nima uchun kerak?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is the "ghost ball" method for?
options: Oq shar kelishi kerak bo'lgan joyni tasavvur qilish / Picturing where the cue ball must land

explanation.uz: Xayoliy shar nishon sharni to'g'ri yo'naltirishga yordam beradi.
explanation.en: The ghost ball helps you aim the object ball accurately.

quiz.uz: 📐 Viktorina: ideal sharoitda shar bortga tekkach qanday burchak bilan qaytadi?
quiz.en: Quiz: in ideal conditions, at what angle does a ball leave a cushion?
options: Ikki baravar katta / Twice as big
Kirish burchagiga teng / Equal to the incoming angle

explanation.en: The angle out equals the angle in.

quiz.uz: 🧵 Viktorina: bilyard kiyining uchi (tip) odatda nimadan yasaladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is a cue tip usually made of?

explanation.uz: Teri uch bo'rni ushlaydi va oq sharga yaxshi ilashadi.
explanation.en: A leather tip holds chalk and grips the cue ball.

quiz.uz: ⚪ Viktorina: zamonaviy bilyard sharlari asosan nimadan yasaladi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what are modern pool balls mostly made of?

explanation.uz: Fenol smolasi chidamli. Qadimda sharlar fil suyagidan ham yasalgan.
explanation.en: Phenolic resin is tough; old balls were also made of ivory.

quiz.uz: 📏 Viktorina: standart bilyard kiyi taxminan necha santimetr uzunlikda?
quiz.en: Quiz: how long is a standard pool cue, roughly?

explanation.en: A standard cue is about 147 cm (58 in).

quiz.uz: ⚪ Viktorina: standart bilyard sharining diametri taxminan qancha?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is the diameter of a standard pool ball, roughly?

quiz.uz: 📐 Viktorina: 9 futlik turnir stolining o'yin maydoni taxminan qancha?
quiz.en: Quiz: how big is the playing area of a 9-foot pool table, roughly?

quiz.uz: 🟡 Viktorina: standart 8-ball to'plamida 1-shar qanday rangda?
quiz.en: Quiz: what colour is ball number 1 in a standard 8-ball set?

explanation.en: 1 yellow, 2 blue, 3 red, 4 purple.

quiz.uz: 🟠 Viktorina: standart to'plamda 5-shar qanday rangda?
quiz.en: Quiz: what colour is ball number 5 in a standard set?

explanation.en: 5 orange, 6 green, 7 maroon, 8 black.

quiz.uz: 🌟 Viktorina: «Sehrgar» laqabli mashhur bilyardchi Efren Reyes qaysi davlatdan?
quiz.en: Quiz: Efren "The Magician" Reyes, a pool legend, comes from which country?

explanation.uz: Reyes filippinlik; 1999-yilda 9-ball bo'yicha jahon chempioni bo'lgan.
explanation.en: Reyes is Filipino and won the 9-ball world title in 1999.

quiz.uz: 🏅 Viktorina: Villi Mosko 1956-yilda ko'rgazmali o'yinda ketma-ket nechta sharni tushirgan (straight pool rekordi)?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many balls in a row did Willie Mosconi pocket in a 1956 straight-pool exhibition?

explanation.uz: 526 ta: bilyard tarixidagi eng mashhur rekordlardan biri.
explanation.en: 526: one of the most famous records in cue sports.

quiz.uz: 🎬 Viktorina: «The Hustler» (1961) filmida bilyardchi «Tez Eddi» rolini kim o'ynagan?
quiz.en: Quiz: who played pool hustler "Fast Eddie" in the 1961 film "The Hustler"?

explanation.uz: Paul Newman; u «Rang puli» (1986) filmida yana shu rolda.
explanation.en: Paul Newman, who returned to the role in "The Color of Money" (1986).

quiz.uz: 🎬 Viktorina: «The Color of Money» (1986) filmida Paul Newman bilan birga kim o'ynagan?
quiz.en: Quiz: who starred alongside Paul Newman in "The Color of Money" (1986)?

explanation.uz: Tom Cruise; film bilyard ustalari haqida.
explanation.en: Tom Cruise; the film is about pool hustlers.

quiz.uz: 🚀 Viktorina: snuker afsonasi Ronni O'Sallivanning laqabi nima?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is snooker legend Ronnie O'Sullivan's nickname?

explanation.uz: «Rocket» (raketa): u juda tez o'ynashi bilan mashhur.
explanation.en: "The Rocket": known for his fast play.

quiz.uz: 📚 Viktorina: inglizcha «cue» so'zi qaysi fransuzcha so'zdan kelgan?
quiz.en: Quiz: the English word "cue" comes from which French word?

explanation.uz: Fransuzcha «queue»: dum. Kiyning shakli dumni eslatgan.
explanation.en: French "queue" means tail, like the stick's shape.

quiz.uz: 🕰 Viktorina: Big Ben qaysi shaharda? O'yinning birinchi stoli ham shu yerda!
quiz.en: Quiz: in which city is Big Ben? It is also the game's first table!

explanation.uz: Big Ben Londonda. London stoli o'yindagi birinchi stol.
explanation.en: Big Ben is in London, and the London table is the game's first.

quiz.uz: 🦘 Viktorina: Opera teatri yelkanga o'xshash tomi bilan mashhur Sidney qaysi mamlakatda?
quiz.en: Quiz: Sydney, famous for its sail-roofed Opera House, is in which country?

explanation.en: In Australia. The game's 2nd table is Harbour Bar.

quiz.uz: 🥧 Viktorina: mashhur «pastel de nata» shirinligi qaysi mamlakatniki?
quiz.en: Quiz: which country is the "pastel de nata" custard tart from?

explanation.en: Portugal; its capital Lisbon is the game's 3rd table.

quiz.uz: ⚽ Viktorina: Santyago Bernabeu stadioni qaysi shaharda?
quiz.en: Quiz: in which city is the Santiago Bernabéu stadium?

explanation.uz: Madridda, «Real» ning uyi. O'yinda Madrid stoli: Plaza Mayor.
explanation.en: In Madrid, home of Real. The game's Madrid table: Plaza Mayor.

quiz.uz: 🗾 Viktorina: Tokio 1868-yilgacha qanday nomda bo'lgan?
quiz.en: Quiz: what was Tokyo called before 1868?

explanation.en: Edo. The "Samurai Dojo" table has that spirit.

quiz.uz: 🥋 Viktorina: yapon tilida «dojo» nima?
quiz.en: Quiz: what is a "dojo" in Japanese?
options: Jang san'atlari mashq zali / A martial-arts training hall

explanation.uz: Dojo: mashq zali. O'yinda Tokio stoli «Samurai Dojo».
explanation.en: A dojo is a training hall. The Tokyo table is "Samurai Dojo".

quiz.uz: 💃 Viktorina: tango raqsi qaysi mamlakat bilan bog'liq (Buenos-Ayres stoli: «Tango Salon»)?
quiz.en: Quiz: which country is the tango dance tied to (Buenos Aires' table: "Tango Salon")?

explanation.uz: Tango Argentina va Urugvay qirg'oqlarida tug'ilgan.
explanation.en: Tango was born on the shores of Argentina and Uruguay.

quiz.uz: 🏝 Viktorina: Jakarta joylashgan Indoneziya taxminan nechta orolga ega?
quiz.en: Quiz: Indonesia, home of Jakarta, has roughly how many islands?

explanation.en: About 17,000 islands. In the game: "Volcano Arena".

quiz.uz: 🍁 Viktorina: Kanada bayrog'idagi barg qaysi daraxtniki (Toronto stoli: «Maple Lounge»)?
quiz.en: Quiz: which tree's leaf is on Canada's flag (Toronto's table: "Maple Lounge")?

explanation.uz: Maple bargi: shuning uchun Toronto stoli «Maple Lounge».
explanation.en: A maple leaf: hence the Toronto table "Maple Lounge".

quiz.uz: 🌋 Viktorina: Mexiko shahri qadimgi qaysi shahar o'rnida qurilgan?
quiz.en: Quiz: on the site of which ancient city was Mexico City built?

explanation.uz: Atsteklar poytaxti Tenochtitlan, ko'l ustidagi shahar.
explanation.en: Tenochtitlan, the Aztec capital built on a lake.

quiz.uz: 🔺 Viktorina: Giza piramidalari qaysi mamlakatda (Qohira stoli: «Pyramid Hall»)?
quiz.en: Quiz: in which country are the Giza pyramids (Cairo's table: "Pyramid Hall")?

explanation.en: In Egypt, next to Cairo.

quiz.uz: 🏙 Viktorina: 828 metrli Burj Xalifa qaysi shaharda?
quiz.en: Quiz: in which city is the 828-metre Burj Khalifa?

explanation.en: In Dubai. The game's Dubai table: "Golden Tower".

quiz.uz: 🦁 Viktorina: «Singapur» nomi «Sher shahri» degan ma'noni bildiradi. To'g'rimi?
quiz.en: Quiz: the name "Singapore" means "Lion City". True or false?

explanation.en: From Sanskrit "simha pura": lion city.

quiz.uz: 🗼 Viktorina: «Sharq marvarid minorasi» (Oriental Pearl Tower) qaysi shaharda?
quiz.en: Quiz: in which city is the Oriental Pearl Tower?

explanation.en: In Shanghai. The game's table: "Pearl Club".

quiz.uz: 🗼 Viktorina: Eyfel minorasi qaysi shaharda?
quiz.en: Quiz: in which city is the Eiffel Tower?

explanation.en: In Paris. The game's table there: "Château Royal".

quiz.uz: 🗽 Viktorina: Nyu-York dastlab qanday nom bilan atalgan?
quiz.en: Quiz: what was New York originally called?

explanation.uz: 1664-yilgacha Yangi Amsterdam. O'yinda ikkala shahar ham bor.
explanation.en: New Amsterdam until 1664. Both cities are in the game.

quiz.uz: 🏛 Viktorina: Kolizey qaysi shaharda?
quiz.en: Quiz: in which city is the Colosseum?

explanation.en: In Rome. In the game the table is "Colosseo".

quiz.uz: 🇹🇭 Viktorina: Bangkok qaysi mamlakatning poytaxti?
quiz.en: Quiz: Bangkok is the capital of which country?

explanation.en: Thailand's capital. In the game: "Golden Temple".

quiz.uz: 🏢 Viktorina: mashhur Petronas egizak minoralari qaysi shaharda?
quiz.en: Quiz: in which city are the famous Petronas Twin Towers?

explanation.en: In Kuala Lumpur. The game's table: "Twin Towers".

quiz.uz: 🇰🇷 Viktorina: Seul qaysi mamlakatning poytaxti?
quiz.en: Quiz: Seoul is the capital of which country?

explanation.uz: Janubiy Koreya poytaxti. O'yinda stol: «Neon Tower».
explanation.en: South Korea's capital. In the game: "Neon Tower".

quiz.uz: 🎬 Viktorina: Mumbay 1995-yilgacha qanday atalgan?
quiz.en: Quiz: what was Mumbai called until 1995?

explanation.uz: Bombay. Bollivud kinosining markazi. O'yinda: «Maharaja Palace».
explanation.en: Bombay, the heart of Bollywood. In the game: "Maharaja Palace".

quiz.uz: 🏅 Viktorina: zamonaviy Olimpiya o'yinlari 1896-yilda qaysi shaharda birinchi marta o'tkazilgan?
quiz.en: Quiz: in which city were the first modern Olympic Games held in 1896?

explanation.en: In Athens. The game's table: "Acropolis Hall".

quiz.uz: 🧱 Viktorina: Berlin devori qaysi yilda qulagan?
quiz.en: Quiz: in which year did the Berlin Wall fall?

explanation.en: On 9 November 1989. The game's table: "Platz Arena".

quiz.uz: 🌉 Viktorina: Istanbul qaysi ikki qit'ada joylashgan?
quiz.en: Quiz: which two continents does Istanbul sit on?
options: Osiyo va Amerika / Asia and America
Yevropa va Osiyo / Europe and Asia
Yevropa va Afrika / Europe and Africa
Osiyo va Afrika / Asia and Africa

explanation.uz: Bosfor bo'g'ozi shaharni ikki qit'aga bo'ladi.
explanation.en: The Bosphorus strait splits the city between two continents.

quiz.uz: 🏠 Viktorina: «Kasablanka» nomi tarjimada nimani anglatadi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what does the name "Casablanca" mean?

explanation.uz: Ispancha casa blanca: oq uy. Shahar Marokashda.
explanation.en: Spanish "casa blanca": white house. The city is in Morocco.

quiz.uz: 🗾 Viktorina: o'yindagi 30 shaharning nechtasi Yaponiyada?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many of the game's 30 cities are in Japan?

explanation.en: Two: Tokyo (Samurai Dojo) and Osaka (Skyline).

quiz.uz: 🚇 Viktorina: Toshkent metrosi qaysi yilda ochilgan (Markaziy Osiyoda birinchi)?
quiz.en: Quiz: in which year did the Tashkent metro open, the first in Central Asia?

explanation.en: On 6 November 1977. In the game: the Tashkent table "Silk Road".

quiz.uz: 🎂 Viktorina: Toshkent qaysi yilda 2200 yilligini nishonlagan?
quiz.en: Quiz: in which year did Tashkent celebrate its 2,200th anniversary?

explanation.en: In 2009. "Tashkent" means "stone city".

quiz.uz: 🗿 Viktorina: «Rio-de-Janeyro» nomi nimani anglatadi?
quiz.en: Quiz: what does the name "Rio de Janeiro" mean?

explanation.en: Portuguese for "January River", named in January 1502.

quiz.uz: ⛪ Viktorina: Vasiliy Blajenniy sobori qaysi maydonda joylashgan?
quiz.en: Quiz: on which square does St Basil's Cathedral stand?

explanation.uz: Moskvadagi Qizil maydonda. O'yinda eng yuqori stol: «Red Square».
explanation.en: On Red Square in Moscow, the game's highest table.

quiz.uz: 🌵 Viktorina: Las-Vegas AQShning qaysi shtatida joylashgan?
quiz.en: Quiz: in which US state is Las Vegas?

explanation.en: In Nevada. The game's table: "Royal Flush".

quiz.uz: 🌷 Viktorina: Amsterdam qaysi mamlakatning poytaxti?
quiz.en: Quiz: Amsterdam is the capital of which country?

explanation.uz: Niderlandiya poytaxti, kanallar shahri. O'yinda: «Canal House».
explanation.en: The Netherlands' capital, a city of canals. In the game: "Canal House".

quiz.uz: 🎱 Viktorina: o'yinda nechta kiy bor (taxminan)?
quiz.en: Quiz: roughly how many cues are there in the game?

explanation.en: Over 470. The collection counter reads "1/471".

quiz.uz: 🌍 Viktorina: o'yinda nechta davlat kiyi bor?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many country cues are in the game?

explanation.uz: 199 ta, har biri o'sha davlat bayrog'i ranglarida.
explanation.en: 199, each in its flag's colours.

quiz.uz: 🧑 Viktorina: nechta portret avatar bepul?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many portrait avatars are free?

explanation.uz: 76 ta portret bepul. Premium avatarlar alohida: 70 ta.
explanation.en: 76 portraits are free; the 70 premium avatars are separate.

quiz.uz: 🎭 Viktorina: o'yinda nechta stiker to'plami bor?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many sticker packs are there?

explanation.uz: 6 ta: Bilyard, Hayvonlar, Kulgi, Taom, Sehr, Mehr.
explanation.en: 6: Billiards, Animals, Funny, Food, Magic, Hearts.

quiz.uz: 🎭 Viktorina: bitta stiker to'plami necha 💎 turadi?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many 💎 does one sticker pack cost?

quiz.uz: 🎁 Viktorina: o'yin vaqtida raqibga nechta xil sovg'a yuborish mumkin?
quiz.en: Quiz: how many kinds of gifts can you send to your opponent in a match?

explanation.en: 13 kinds, from a heart to a jet.

🎱 The cue: your signature
Everyone at the table sees your cue. From a simple one to a legendary one: find yours among 470+. Besides the looks, the stats differ too: force, aim, spin, time.

en:
🇺🇿 The Uzbekistan cue: your flag in your hands
Blue, with a crescent. In "Shop · Cues · Country": 40 💵 or 400 💎. The cues of 198 other countries are there too.

uz:
🌈 Kamalak opal: dunyoda atigi 300 ta
Premium kiylar seriyasining eng nodiri. Bronzadan boshlab nusxalar kamayib boradi: 5 000, 4 000, 3 000... va 300. Tugagach, boshqa chiqmaydi. Egasi tartib raqamini oladi.
en:
🌈 Rainbow Opal: only 300 in the world
The rarest of the premium cue series. The copies shrink from Bronze on: 5,000, 4,000, 3,000... down to 300. When they are gone, they are gone. The owner gets a serial number.

uz:

en:
💀 Horror cues: into the dark style?
Mystic Night, Midnight, Grave Bell and more: 12 in total. The weekly offer in the shop rotates, so check whose turn it is this week.

uz:

Do'kondagi «Stollar» bo'limining eng tepasida bu haftaning chegirmali stoli turadi. Har dushanba yangisi almashadi, shuning uchun yoqqan bo'lsa, kutib o'tirmang.
en:
🛒 Shop: a table at −40% this week
At the very top of the shop's "Tables" section sits this week's discounted table. A new one replaces it every Monday, so if you like it, do not wait.

uz:

en:
🪑 The table: your stage
The table you pick shows in all your games and your opponent sees it too. Over 150 tables: from plain colours to rare limited editions.

uz:

en:
🖼 Frames: from 5,000 🪙
Bronze frame 5,000 🪙, Silver 25,000 🪙, Gold 150,000 🪙. The frame glows around your avatar in the ranking, the lobby and at the table. Add a little glamour to the coins you win.

uz:

Bronzadan Kamalak opalgacha 12 daraja, soni 5 000 dan 300 gacha. Sotilib bo'lganlarini keyin sotib bo'lmaydi: qaysi daraja sizniki?
en:
💎 Limited frames: who is first?
12 tiers from Bronze to Rainbow Opal, from 5,000 copies down to 300. Sold-out ones can no longer be bought: which tier will be yours?

uz:

en:
🧑 Premium avatars: from 20,000 🪙
70 premium avatars in 5 rarities: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic. The cheapest is 20,000 🪙 and the rarest cost 💵. Your picture is your business card.

🙂 Pick the avatar that fits you
76 portraits are free: find one that looks like you. Want to stand out more? Premium avatars are in the "Avatars" section.

en:
✈️ The jet: the biggest gift
The jet that flies to your opponent is worth 👍 ×7,000 and costs 100 💵. The car is ×5,000, the bike ×3,000. Big respect after a big game!

en:
🍫 Cheap gifts: heart, clover, chocolate
Clover and chocolate are free every day. A heart costs 15 🪙, up to 5 a day. The cheapest sign of respect for coins: send one after a good game.

The starter cue is free. Plane Tree 4,000 🪙, Candy 18,000 🪙 and more. After your first wins, treat yourself to a new cue!

🏆 Cues you cannot buy
You do not buy Victory cues, you win them: collect pieces by winning in the listed city. Each cue takes 4 pieces. Which city will you start with?

🎁 The surprise box: what will it be?
Legendary cues such as Axiom or Crystal Blade come out of surprise boxes. The best part: you never know what you will get.

Open until the month ends: the premium track gives many more cues, frames, tables and avatars. The free track is open to all. How long is left? The pass has a timer.

💍 Win the ring: the table is free
Win a city's ring and that city's table is yours for free. An easy start: London's ring takes just 4 wins, Sydney's 5. Which city's table will be your first?

en:
🧰 Opening a box: what will it be?
The higher the box, the more perks inside: 1, 2 or 3. You never know what comes out, so every box is a little celebration.

en:
✨ The full look: avatar, frame, cue, table
The avatar is your face, the frame its border, the cue your signature and the table the stage. Put it all together and stand out in the ranking and at the table.

uz:

en:
👑 A premium cue: a limited edition with a serial number
Premium cues are limited: every owner gets a serial number such as "№ 17 / 300". The lower your number, the rarer. Shop · Cues · Premium.

uz:
🌍 Davlat kiyi: 199 davlat, 199 bayroq
Har bir davlatning kiyi o'z bayrog'i ranglarida. Do'kon · Kiylar · Mamlakat bo'limida o'z davlatingizni, yoki yoqqan boshqasini toping. Narxi: 40 💵 yoki 400 💎.
en:
🌍 A country cue: 199 countries, 199 flags
Each country's cue wears its own flag colours. In Shop · Cues · Country find your own country or another you like. The price: 40 💵 or 400 💎.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: sindirishda oq sharni nazoratda saqlang
Boshlang'ich zarbada eng kuchli urish shart emas. Oq shar uchburchakka to'g'ri tegsin va stol o'rtasida qolsin: shunda keyingi zarbangiz oson bo'ladi.
en:
💡 Tip: keep the cue ball under control on the break
You do not have to hit the break with full force. Let the cue ball meet the rack squarely and stay near the middle of the table, and your next shot is easy.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: oson sharlardan boshlang
Qiyin sharni birinchi urmang. Avval oson sharlarni tushiring, oq sharni keyingi qiyin shar yoniga olib keling. Natijada stolda faqat oson zarbalar qoladi.
en:
💡 Tip: start with the easy balls
Do not shoot the hard ball first. Pocket the easy ones and bring the cue ball next to the harder one. You end up with only easy shots on the table.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: 8-sharni oxiriga qoldiring, lekin yo'lini oldindan tozalang
O'z guruhingiz oxirgi shari tushganda 8-shar cho'ntakka ochiq yo'lda turishi kerak. Oxirgi 2–3 zarbadan oldin 8-shar yo'lida to'siq bormi, tekshiring.
en:
💡 Tip: leave the 8-ball for last, but clear its path early
When your last group ball drops, the 8-ball needs a clear path to a pocket. Before your last 2-3 shots, check whether anything blocks it.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: yo'l to'silsa, bortdan aylaning
Raqibning shari yo'lingizni to'ssa, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri urishga urinmang: oq sharni bortga uring (kick shot). Burchak kirish burchagiga teng qaytadi.
en:
💡 Tip: if the path is blocked, go round the cushion
When an opponent's ball blocks you, do not force the direct shot: send the cue ball off a cushion (a kick shot). The angle out equals the angle in.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: ingichka zarbada kuchni pasaytiring
Nishon sharni faqat chetidan ilashtirsangiz (ingichka kesim), kuchli urmang. Sekin zarba aniqroq bo'ladi va oq shar ham uzoqqa ketmaydi.
en:
💡 Tip: soften the power on a thin cut
When you only clip the edge of the object ball (a thin cut), do not hit hard. A slow shot is more accurate and the cue ball does not run away.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: oq sharning keyingi o'rnini o'ylang
Zarba tushdi, endi oq shar qayerda to'xtaydi? Pastdan urish (draw) uni orqaga tortadi, yuqoridan urish (follow) oldinga yuritadi. Mashq rejimida ikkalasini sinab ko'ring.
en:
💡 Tip: think about where the cue ball will stop
The ball dropped, but where does the cue ball end up? Hitting low (draw) pulls it back, hitting high (follow) sends it forward. Try both in Practice mode.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: oq sharni bort yoniga qoldirmang
Bort yonidagi oq shar bilan zarba qiyinlashadi. Sharni stolning o'rtasiga yaqin qoldirishga harakat qiling: u yerdan hamma tomonga yo'l ochiq.
en:
💡 Tip: do not leave the cue ball against the cushion
A cue ball hugging the cushion makes the next shot hard. Try to leave it near the middle of the table: from there every direction is open.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: kombinatsiyani qidiring
Ikki shar bir-biriga yaqin turganda birinchisini ursangiz, u ikkinchisini cho'ntakka itarishi mumkin. Bunday zarba kam uchraydi, lekin raqibni hayratda qoldiradi.
en:
💡 Tip: look for the combination
When two balls sit close together, hitting the first can push the second into a pocket. Such shots are rare, but they impress your opponent.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: har zarbada vaqt bor
Navbatingiz boshlanishi bilan taymer yuradi. Zarbani oldindan rejalashtiring: raqib zarba urayotganda keyingi sharlaringizni hisoblab qo'ying.
en:
💡 Tip: every shot has a clock
The timer runs as soon as your turn starts. Plan the shot ahead: work out your next balls while your opponent is shooting.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: avval o'z guruhingiz sharini uring
Oq shar birinchi bo'lib raqibning sharini yoki 8-sharni ursa, qoida buzilishi bo'ladi va raqib oq sharni xohlagan joyga qo'yadi. Nishonni diqqat bilan tanlang.
en:
💡 Tip: hit your own group first
If the cue ball touches an opponent's ball or the 8-ball first, it is a foul and your opponent can place the cue ball anywhere. Choose your target carefully.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: oq shar qo'lingizda bo'lsa, ikki zarbani rejalashtiring
Oq sharni xohlagan joyga qo'yish imkonini bersa, faqat bitta sharni emas, keyingi sharni ham o'ylang: oq shar birinchi zarbadan keyin ikkinchisiga qulay joyda to'xtasin.
en:
💡 Tip: with the cue ball in hand, plan two shots
When you may place the cue ball anywhere, think about the next ball too, not just one: let the cue ball finish in a good spot for the second shot.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: har kuni 5 daqiqa mashq
Mashq rejimida bitta qiyin zarbani 10 marta takrorlang. Bir haftadan keyin qiyin zarba odatiy bo'lib qoladi. Bunda tanga ham, reyting ham xavf ostida emas.
en:
💡 Tip: 5 minutes of practice a day
In Practice mode repeat one hard shot 10 times. After a week the hard shot becomes routine. Neither coins nor ranking are at stake.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: aylanishni oz-ozdan qo'shing
Yon aylanish (English) oq shar yo'lini o'zgartiradi. Boshlang'ich darajada oz miqdorda ishlating, aks holda zarba aniqligi buziladi. Avval Mashq rejimida kuzating.
en:
💡 Tip: add spin little by little
Side spin ("English") bends the cue ball's path. Use a small amount at first, or your accuracy suffers. Watch it in Practice mode first.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: nishon chizig'ini barmog'ingiz bilan to'smang
Telefonda nishonni aniq ko'rish uchun barmoqni chizig'ingiz yonidan uzoqroq tuting. Aniq nishon yarim g'alaba.
en:
💡 Tip: do not hide the aim line with your finger
On a phone, keep your finger away from the aim line so you can see it clearly. A clear aim is half the win.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: qiyin zarbadan oldin xavf va foydani solishtiring
Qiyin zarba urilmasa, raqibga qulay holat qoladi. Foydasi kichik, xavfi katta bo'lsa, himoya (safety) tanlang: oq sharni raqib sharlari orqasiga yashiring.
en:
💡 Tip: weigh risk against reward before a hard shot
A missed hard shot leaves your opponent a good position. If the reward is small and the risk is big, play safe: hide the cue ball behind your opponent's balls.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: butun tangangizni bitta o'yinga sarflamang
Stolni hamyoningizga mos tanlang. Yutqazish ham o'yinning bir qismi: tangangiz bir necha o'yinga yetsin, shunda ruhiy bosim kam bo'ladi va zarbalar aniqroq chiqadi.
en:
💡 Tip: do not put all your coins on one match
Choose a table that fits your wallet. Losing is part of the game: if your coins last for several matches, there is less pressure and your shots come out cleaner.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: kuchli raqib oldida sabr qiling
Kuchli raqib ham xato qiladi. Shoshilmang, oddiy zarbalarni ishonch bilan uring va uning xatosini kuting. Ko'pincha o'yinni sabrli o'yinchi yutadi.
en:
💡 Tip: be patient against a strong opponent
Even a strong opponent makes mistakes. Do not rush, play the simple shots with confidence and wait for the slip. Often the patient player wins.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: sportcha o'ynang
O'yin tugagach «Yaxshi o'yin» deb yozing, yurak yuboring. G'alabada ham, mag'lubiyatda ham hurmat saqlang: shunda raqiblar siz bilan yana o'ynashni xohlaydi.
en:
💡 Tip: be a good sport
After the match type "Good game" and send a heart. Keep your respect in a win and in a loss: that way opponents want to play you again.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: ko'zingizni asrang
Bir soat o'ynagach 5 daqiqa tanaffus qiling: uzoqqa qarang, suv iching. Ko'z va qo'l dam olsa, zarbalar aniqroq bo'ladi. O'yin dam olish uchun, charchash uchun emas.
en:
💡 Tip: look after your eyes
After an hour of play take a 5-minute break: look into the distance, drink some water. Rested eyes and hands shoot better. The game is for relaxing, not for wearing yourself out.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: yangi o'yinchi uchun yo'l
London → Sidney → Lissabon: avval birinchi uzukni yig'ing (4 ta g'alaba), keyin keyingisini. Har uzuk yangi stol va yangi kubokni ochadi.
en:
💡 Tip: a path for new players
London → Sydney → Lisbon: collect the first ring first (4 wins), then the next one. Each ring opens a new table and a new cup.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: kunlik kubokka oldindan tayyorlaning
Kubok ochilishidan 10 daqiqa oldin Mashq rejimida qizinib oling. Ochilgach 3 soat bor, lekin tayyor bo'lsangiz, birinchi raundda ham xato qilmaysiz.
en:
💡 Tip: warm up before the daily cup
Warm up in Practice mode 10 minutes before the cup opens. You have 3 hours once it does, but if you are ready you will not slip even in round one.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: bir zarbada ikki shar
Ikki shar bir-biriga yaqin bo'lsa va cho'ntak oldida bo'lsa, ikkalasini bitta zarbada tushirish mumkin. «Ajoyib o'yin» medalini shunday olasiz: ichida 1 000 🪙 bor.
en:
💡 Tip: two balls with one shot
If two balls are close together near a pocket, you may drop both with one shot. That is how you earn the "Great game" medal, with 1,000 🪙 inside.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: sindirishda shar tushiring
Birinchi zarbada shar tushirsangiz, «Tezkor» medalini olasiz. Oq sharni uchburchak uchi bilan to'g'ri ro'para qiling va o'rtacha kuchli uring.
en:
💡 Tip: pot a ball on the break
Pot a ball on the break and you earn the "Quick" medal. Line the cue ball up squarely with the head ball and hit with moderate power.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: sharning qaysi qismiga urishni biling
Nishon shar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri cho'ntak tomon ketishi uchun, oq shar uning cho'ntakka qarama-qarshi tomoniga tegishi kerak. Xayoliy shar usuli shu yerda yordam beradi.
en:
💡 Tip: know where to hit the ball
For the object ball to head straight for the pocket, the cue ball must touch it on the side opposite the pocket. The ghost-ball method helps here.

uz:
💡 Maslahat: kichik maqsadlar qo'ying
Bugun 3 ta g'alaba, ertaga uzuk, indinga yangi shahar. Kichik maqsadlar yo'lni qisqartiradi va har kuni sizni o'yinga qaytaradi. Maqsadingiz nima?
en:
💡 Tip: set small goals
Today 3 wins, tomorrow a ring, the day after a new city. Small goals shorten the road and bring you back every day. What is yours?

poll.en: Which daily cup do you play most?

What would you like to see more of in the channel?

uz:
🎱 Oxirgi shar
Stolda faqat 8-shar qoldi. Raqibingiz ham bitta zarba uzoqlikda. Qo'lingiz yengil titraydi, taymer yuradi... Nafas oling, nishonni to'g'rilang va uring. Bilyard aynan shu daqiqalar uchun yaratilgan.
en:
🎱 The last ball
Only the 8-ball is left. Your opponent is one shot away too. Your hand trembles a little, the timer runs... Breathe, line up the aim and shoot. Cue sports exist for moments like this.

uz:
😏 «Men sendan kuchliman»
Do'stingiz shunday dedimi? Gapirib o'tirmang: lobbi oching, kodni yuboring va stolda isbotlang. Ovozli xonani yoqing: hamma kim haq ekanini eshitsin!
en:
😏 "I am better than you"
Did your friend say that? Do not argue: open a lobby, send the code and prove it at the table. Turn on the voice room so everyone hears who is right!

uz:
🌅 🌞 🌆 🌙 Kunning to'rt imkoniyati
09:00, 15:00, 21:00 va 03:00 (Toshkent vaqti bilan). To'rt kubok, to'rt imkoniyat. Ertalabkisini o'tkazib yuborgan bo'lsangiz, tushdagisini ushlab oling. Bugun qaysi birida o'ynaysiz?
en:
🌅 🌞 🌆 🌙 Four chances a day
09:00, 15:00, 21:00 and 03:00 (Tashkent time). Four cups, four chances. Missed the morning one? Catch the afternoon one. Which will you play today?

uz:
🛣 London'dan Toshkentgacha
Birinchi stol London: kirish atigi 50 🪙. 27-stol Toshkent: kirish 65 000 000 🪙. Orada 25 ta shahar, har birining o'z uzugi. Siz hozir qaysi shahardasiz?
en:
🛣 From London to Tashkent
The first table is London: entry just 50 🪙. The 27th is Tashkent: entry 65,000,000 🪙. Between them 25 cities, each with its own ring. Which city are you in right now?

uz:
🏳 Bayroqlar bellashadi
Davlat reytingida har davlatning o'z jadvali bor, hafta oxirida eng yaxshi uchtasi 💵 oladi. Sizning bayrog'ingiz qaysi o'rinda bo'ladi? Birinchi g'alabadan boshlang.
en:
🏳 Flags compete
Every country has its own ranking board, and at the end of the week the best three receive 💵. Where will your flag be? Start with your first win.

uz:
🎙 Ovoz bilan boshqacha
Matn yozib o'tirmaysiz: «Zo'r zarba!», «Oh, oz qoldi!», kulgi, hayrat... Ovozli xona o'yinni jonli suhbatga aylantiradi. Do'stlaringizni lobbiga chaqiring va sinab ko'ring.
en:
🎙 Different with voice
No typing: "Great shot!", "Oh, so close!", laughter, gasps... The voice room turns the game into a live conversation. Invite your friends to a lobby and try it.

uz:
📅 Mukammal kun rejasi
Ertalab: kunlik sovg'a va omad g'ildiragi. Tushda: kunlik kubok. Kechqurun: do'stlar bilan lobbi va ovozli xona. Tunda: bugun nechta medal yig'ganingizni sanang. Hammasi bepul boshlanadi.
en:
📅 A perfect day plan
Morning: the daily gift and the lucky wheel. Noon: a daily cup. Evening: a lobby with friends and the voice room. Night: count the medals you collected today. It all starts for free.

uz:
🔥 Bugungi chaqiriq: ketma-ket g'alabalar
5 ta ketma-ket g'alaba «Ketma-ket g'alaba» medalini beradi, 10 tasi esa «Sovuq qon» ni. Har medal 1 000 🪙. Bitta yutqazish seriyani uzadi, shuning uchun diqqat bilan!
en:
🔥 Today's challenge: wins in a row
5 wins in a row earn the "Win streak" medal and 10 earn "Cold blood". Each medal pays 1,000 🪙. One loss breaks the streak, so stay sharp!

uz:
💍 Bugun birinchi uzukni yig'ing
London stolida uzuk uchun 15 kubok kerak, har g'alaba +4, mag'lubiyatda yo'qotish yo'q. Atigi 4 g'alaba. Bugun shuni sinab ko'ring: boshlaymizmi?
en:
💍 Collect your first ring today
At the London table the ring needs 15 trophies, +4 per win and nothing lost on a loss. Just 4 wins. Try it today: shall we start?
(Claim "Bir soatda bo'lishi mumkin": unverifiable. Remove: "Bugun shu uzukni yig'ib ko'ring." Edit below.)

uz:
📲 Cho'ntagingizdagi bilyard zali
Navbat kutayotganda, yo'lda, tanaffusda: Telegram'ni oching, bir bosish va siz stol oldidasiz. Yuklab olish ham, o'rnatish ham yo'q. Qisqa o'yin uchun mukammal.
en:
📲 A billiard hall in your pocket
Waiting in a queue, on the road, on a break: open Telegram, one tap and you are at the table. No download, no install. Perfect for a quick game.

uz:
❤️ Yaxshi o'yindan keyin yurak yuboring
Raqib yaxshi o'ynadimi? Kichik yurak 15 🪙, yonca va shokolad esa kuniga bepul. Bir kichik sovg'a kayfiyatni ko'taradi va ertaga yana o'ynashga undaydi.
en:
❤️ Send a heart after a good game
Did your opponent play well? A little heart is 15 🪙, and the clover and chocolate are free every day. One small gift lifts the mood and brings you back tomorrow.

uz:
🧭 Yangi boshlovchi uchun 3 qadam
1) Botni oching va «O'ynash» ni bosing.
2) London stolini tanlang: birinchi stol hammaga ochiq.
3) Kunlik sovg'ani va omad g'ildiragini oling.
Qolganini o'yinning o'zi ko'rsatadi.
en:
🧭 3 steps for a new player
1) Open the bot and tap Play. 2) Pick the London table: the first table is open to everyone. 3) Collect the daily gift and spin the lucky wheel. The game shows you the rest.

uz:
🔁 7 kunlik seriya
7 kun ketma-ket kirsangiz «Vaqtida» medalini olasiz (1 000 🪙). Kunlik sovg'alar yo'li ham har kuni kattalashadi: 1-kun 100 🪙, 7-kun esa katta sovrin. Bugun nechanchi kundasiz?
en:
🔁 A 7-day streak
Open the game 7 days in a row and you get the "On time" medal (1,000 🪙). The reward route also grows every day: day 1 is 100 🪙, day 7 a big prize. Which day are you on?

uz:
🥷 Qanday o'yinchi bo'lmoqchisiz?
Sovuq qonli ustozmi, tezkor hujumchimi yoki jim rejalashtiruvchimi? O'yin uslubingizni o'zingiz yarating: har g'alaba uni mustahkamlaydi, har mag'lubiyat esa o'rgatadi.
en:
🥷 What kind of player do you want to be?
A cold-blooded master, a fast attacker or a quiet planner? Build your own style: every win strengthens it and every loss teaches you something.

uz:
🗓 Yangi hafta: hamma noldan boshlaydi
Bugun ertalab soat 05:00 da hafta yopildi: reyting va Showdown yangilandi. Ochkolar nolga qaytdi, hamma bir xil boshlaydi. Birinchi g'alabani hoziroq yozdiring!
en:
🗓 A new week: everyone starts from zero
At 05:00 this morning the week closed: the ranking and Showdown reset. Points are back to zero and everyone starts level. Log the first win right now!

uz:
🔥 Dushanba: uchta narsa yangilandi
1) Haftalik reyting nolga qaytdi. 2) Showdown yangi haftaga o'tdi. 3) Do'konda «Haftaning stoli» (−40%) va haftalik «Qo'rqinchli» takliflar almashdi. Bugun nimadan boshlaysiz?
en:
🔥 Monday: three things refreshed
1) The weekly ranking is back to zero. 2) Showdown moved to a new week. 3) The shop's "Table of the week" (−40%) and the weekly horror offers have changed. Where will you start today?

uz:
🏁 Dushanba: haftalik marafon boshlandi
Dunyo va davlat reytingining 1-o'rni uchun 1 500 va 400 💵 beriladi. Ligangizda yuqoriga chiqish uchun eng yaxshi 20% ga kirish kerak. Hafta uzun: shoshilmang, lekin boshlang!
en:
🏁 Monday: the weekly marathon has started
1st place in the world and country rankings gets 1,500 and 400 💵. To move up in your league you need to be in the top 20%. The week is long: no rush, but do start!

uz:
🧭 Dushanba: haftalik reja
Bu hafta uchun 3 ta maqsad: 1) kamida 5 ta g'alaba, 2) bitta yangi medal (+1 000 🪙), 3) Showdown'dan bitta mukofot. Hafta yakshanba kechasigacha: maqsadlarni bugundan boshlang!
en:
🧭 Monday: the weekly plan
3 goals for this week: 1) at least 5 wins, 2) one new medal (+1,000 🪙), 3) one Showdown reward. The week runs until Sunday night: start on your goals today!

uz:
🗓 Oyning oxirgi dushanbasi: yangi hafta, mavsum yakuniga yaqin
Hafta yangidan boshlandi, Mavsum yo'li esa oy tugashi bilan yopiladi: bir-ikki kun qoldi. Yig'ilgan mukofotlarni olib, qolgan ochkolarni yig'ib ulguring!
en:
🗓 The last Monday of the month: a new week, the season nearly over
The week has started afresh, and the Season Pass closes with the month: just a day or two left. Claim your rewards and squeeze in the remaining points!

uz:
🎉 Juma kechasi: hafta oxiri boshlandi
Do'stlaringizni lobbiga chaqiring yoki «Ochiq lobbilar» ga kiring: kimdir albatta o'ynashga tayyor. Ovozli xona bilan hazil ham bo'ladi. Dam olish kunlari qiziqarli o'tsin!
en:
🎉 Friday night: the weekend has started
Invite your friends to a lobby or head to "Open lobbies": someone is surely ready to play. With the voice room there is banter too. Have a fun weekend!

uz:
🎙 Dam olish oldidan: do'stlar bilan ovozli xona
Kod yuboring, 8 kishigacha yig'iling va gaplashib o'ynang. Kim stolda kuchli, kim gapda kuchli: bugun aniq bo'ladi!
en:
🎙 Before the weekend: a voice room with friends
Send a code, gather up to 8 players and talk while you play. Who is strong at the table and who is strong at talking: tonight we will see!

uz:
⏳ Haftaning stoli −40%: dushanbagacha
Bu haftaning chegirmali stoli dushanba ertalab (05:00) yangisiga almashadi. Yoqqan bo'lsa, dam olish kunlarida tanlab oling: do'kon · Stollar bo'limining eng tepasida.
en:
⏳ Table of the week at −40%: until Monday
This week's discounted table is replaced on Monday morning (05:00). If you like it, pick it up this weekend: it sits at the top of the shop's Tables section.

uz:
⏰ Hafta yopilishiga bir necha soat qoldi
Dushanba ertalab soat 05:00 da hafta yopiladi. Reytingda o'rningizni tekshiring: dunyo top-3 ga 1 500 / 750 / 400 💵, davlat top-3 ga 400 / 200 / 100 💵 beriladi. Oxirgi g'alabalar sizni baland ko'tarishi mumkin!
en:
⏰ A few hours until the week closes
The week closes on Monday at 05:00. Check your place in the ranking: the world's top 3 get 1,500 / 750 / 400 💵 and each country's top 3 get 400 / 200 / 100 💵. A few last wins can lift you up!

uz:
♞ Yakshanba: Showdown mukofotlarini oling
Showdown haftasi tugashiga oz qoldi. Ochkolaringiz qaysi mukofot bosqichiga yetdi? Oxirgi bosqichgacha bir-ikki g'alaba qolgan bo'lsa, hozir vaqti.
en:
♞ Sunday: collect your Showdown rewards
The Showdown week is almost over. Which reward stage have your points reached? If you are a win or two from the next stage, now is the time.

uz:
⭐ Ligada qolish yoki ko'tarilish: bugun hal bo'ladi
Har hafta ligangizning eng yaxshi 20% i yuqoriga chiqadi, oxirgi 20% i pastga tushadi. Hafta yopilishidan oldin joyingizni tekshirib, xavfdan qoching!
en:
⭐ Stay or move up: it is decided today
Every week the top 20% of your league move up and the bottom 20% move down. Check your place before the week closes and keep out of danger!

uz:
⏱ Hafta oxirgi soatlarida: yana bir medal yoki uzuk?
Haftalik reyting va Showdown bugun tunda soat 05:00 da yangilanadi. Qolgan vaqtda bitta medal yoki shahar uzugini olishga ulgurasizmi? Bir-ikki g'alaba ko'p narsani o'zgartiradi.
en:
⏱ The final hours of the week: one more medal or ring?
The weekly ranking and Showdown reset tonight at 05:00. Can you fit in one medal or a city ring before then? A win or two can change a lot.

uz:
⏳ Hafta ham, oy ham tugash arafasida
Haftalik reyting dushanba ertalab soat 05:00 da yopiladi, Mavsum yo'li esa oy bilan birga yopilishiga oz qoldi. Mukofotlaringizni olib, oxirgi g'alabalarni yozdirishga ulguring!
en:
⏳ The week and the month are both nearly over
The weekly ranking closes on Monday at 05:00 and the Season Pass is about to close with the month. Claim your rewards and log your last wins in time!

uz:
🌫 Yangi oy, yangi mavsum: «Tuman shohligi»
Mavsum yo'li noldan boshlandi: 400 daraja, yangi kiylar, ramkalar, stollar va avatarlar. Bepul yo'l hammaga ochiq. G'alaba va vazifalar uchun ochko yig'ing!
en:
🌫 A new month, a new season: "Kingdom of Mist"
The Season Pass started from scratch: 400 levels with new cues, frames, tables and avatars. The free track is open to everyone. Earn points from wins and missions!

uz:
⏳ «Tuman shohligi» bugun tunda tugaydi
Mavsum yo'li ertaga ertalab soat 05:00 da yopiladi. Yig'ilgan mukofotlarni olishni unutmang. Ertadan yangi mavsum: «Qor malikasi».
en:
⏳ "Kingdom of Mist" ends tonight
The Season Pass closes tomorrow morning at 05:00. Do not forget to claim your collected rewards. From tomorrow a new season: "Snow Queen".

uz:
❄️ Yangi mavsum: «Qor malikasi»
Dekabr keldi, Mavsum yo'li yangilandi: 400 daraja va yangi mukofotlar. Qishki kayfiyatda o'ynang. Kechagi mavsum yopildi, yangisida hamma noldan boshlaydi.
en:
❄️ A new season: "Snow Queen"
December is here and the Season Pass is renewed: 400 levels and new rewards. Play in a wintery mood. Last month's season is closed, and in the new one everybody starts from zero.

uz:
🇺🇿 Konstitutsiya kuni muborak!
Bayram kayfiyatida do'stlaringiz bilan lobbi oching yoki Toshkent stolida («Silk Road») o'ynab ko'ring. Hamma o'yinchilarimizga tinchlik, quvonch va omad tilaymiz!
en:
🇺🇿 Happy Constitution Day!
In a festive mood open a lobby with friends or try the Tashkent table ("Silk Road"). We wish all our players peace, joy and good luck!

uz:
🎄 Yangi yilgacha 5 kun
Yangi yil oldidan do'stlaringiz bilan lobbi oching: kim yilni g'alaba bilan yakunlaydi? Ovozli xona bilan bayram oldi kayfiyati yanada yorqin bo'ladi.
en:
🎄 5 days until New Year
Open a lobby with your friends before the holiday: who will end the year with a win? The voice room makes the pre-holiday mood even brighter.

uz:
🎆 Yangi yil bilan!
Yil oxirgi soatlari. Bugun tunda soat 05:00 da dekabr mavsumi yopiladi: kutilgan mukofotlarni oling. Yangi yilda barchaga sog'lik, quvonch va ko'p g'alaba tilaymiz!
en:
🎆 Happy New Year!
The last hours of the year. Tonight at 05:00 the December season closes: collect any rewards waiting for you. We wish everyone health, joy and many wins in the new year!

uz:
❄️ Yangi yil, yangi mavsum: «Muz saltanati»
Yangi yilning birinchi kuni Mavsum yo'li yangilandi: 400 daraja, yangi mukofotlar. Yilni birinchi g'alabadan boshlang!
en:
❄️ A new year, a new season: "Ice Kingdom"
On the first day of the year the Season Pass is renewed: 400 levels, new rewards. Start the year with your first win!

uz:
🎯 Yangi yil uchun 3 ta o'yin maqsadi
1) Birinchi uzukni yig'ing (London: 4 g'alaba). 2) Bitta medalni oling (+1 000 🪙). 3) Do'stlar bilan lobbi oching. Kichik maqsadlar katta yutuqqa olib boradi.
en:
🎯 3 game goals for the new year
1) Collect your first ring (London: 4 wins). 2) Earn one medal (+1,000 🪙). 3) Open a lobby with friends. Small goals lead to big wins.

uz:
🇺🇿 Vatan himoyachilari kuni muborak!
Bayram bilan! Bugun dilni tinchitib, do'stlar bilan bir-ikki o'yin o'ynang. Sog'lik, tinchlik va omad tilaymiz!
en:
🇺🇿 Happy Defenders of the Motherland Day!
Congratulations! Relax today and play a game or two with friends. We wish you health, peace and good luck!

uz:
⏳ «Muz saltanati» bugun tunda tugaydi
Mavsum yo'li ertaga ertalab soat 05:00 da yopiladi. Yig'ilgan mukofotlarni oling. Ertadan yangi mavsum: «Sevgi bog'i».
en:
⏳ "Ice Kingdom" ends tonight
The Season Pass closes tomorrow morning at 05:00. Claim your collected rewards. From tomorrow a new season: "Garden of Love".

uz:
💗 Yangi mavsum: «Sevgi bog'i»
Fevral keldi, Mavsum yo'li yangilandi: 400 daraja va yangi mukofotlar. Yangi oyni birinchi g'alabadan boshlang!
en:
💗 A new season: "Garden of Love"
February is here and the Season Pass is renewed: 400 levels and new rewards. Start the new month with your first win!

uz:
💘 14-fevral: «Mehr» stikerlari
💗 💙 💖 💔 ❤️ 🌹 🎁 💘: 8 ta iliq stiker do'stingizga iliq so'z yuborish uchun. Har to'plam 10 💵 yoki 100 💎. Yaxshi o'yindan keyin yurak sovg'asi ham yubora olasiz.
en:
💘 14 February: the "Hearts" stickers
💗 💙 💖 💔 ❤️ 🌹 🎁 💘: 8 warm stickers for sending a kind word to a friend. Each pack costs 10 💵 or 100 💎. After a good game you can send a heart gift too.

uz:
⏳ «Sevgi bog'i» bugun tunda tugaydi
Mavsum yo'li ertaga ertalab soat 05:00 da yopiladi. Yig'ilgan mukofotlarni olishni unutmang. Ertadan yangi mavsum: «Bahor uyg'onishi».
en:
⏳ "Garden of Love" ends tonight
The Season Pass closes tomorrow morning at 05:00. Do not forget your collected rewards. From tomorrow a new season: "Spring Awakening".

uz:
🌱 Yangi mavsum: «Bahor uyg'onishi»
Mart keldi, Mavsum yo'li yangilandi: 400 daraja, yangi mukofotlar. Bahor kayfiyatida yangi mavsumni birinchi g'alabadan boshlang!
en:
🌱 A new season: "Spring Awakening"
March is here and the Season Pass is renewed: 400 levels, new rewards. In a spring mood, start the new season with your first win!

uz:
💐 8-mart bayrami muborak!
Aziz ayollarimiz, o'yinchilarimiz va kanal a'zolarimiz, bayramingiz muborak! O'yinda gul dastasi sovg'asi bor 💐: yaxshi o'yindan keyin raqibingizga yuboring.
en:
💐 Happy International Women's Day!
To our dear women, players and channel members: happy holiday! The game has a bouquet gift 💐: send one to your opponent after a good game.

uz:
🌷 Navro'z bayrami muborak!
Bahor va yangilanish bayrami bilan! Bugun do'stlar bilan lobbi oching va yangi mavsumni baxtli boshlang. Hammaga tinchlik, farovonlik va omad tilaymiz!
en:
🌷 Happy Navruz!
Congratulations on the holiday of spring and renewal! Open a lobby with friends today and start the new season happily. We wish everyone peace, prosperity and good luck!
